verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents an agent that resolves issues end-to-end across channels and takes real actions through customer APIs and MCP servers within workflows. It backs this with resolution-oriented measurement: resolution-quality analytics, projected resolution quality from replayed tickets, a quality score on 100% of conversations, and a refund of the AI portion when Coach scores a conversation badly. All evidence is vendor-claimed, and it scopes deployment to trained topics, leaving the rest with the human team. Missing for 10: published resolution-rate figures showing a meaningful share, an explicit metric definition distinguishing resolutions from deflections, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
